reader.notes: Each relative connector entry assigns Status before it returns. The emitter stores the file status and runs EmitUseHook before the INVALID KEY branch, so the imperative and any USE procedure both see the 2x value. Each status was planted as 99 first and every probe overwrote it with the right value. The one edition arm, the key-0 WRITE, takes the 1985-correct 24.

refuter.evidence: Probe r3_ik.cob at --std 85 (runs/r3_ik-001), each status planted as 99 first: START on an empty file 23; random READ, DELETE and REWRITE with key 0 each 23; REWRITE of absent RRN 5 23; START GREATER THAN past the last record 23; START EQUAL to an existing record and GREATER THAN 0 both take NOT INVALID KEY with 00; OPEN EXTEND of a 9-record file with SK PIC 9, then WRITE gives 24 with SK 9, and a re-read counts 9 records then 10, so the file is not affected. r2_global.cob (runs/r2_global-001): a containing program's USE GLOBAL procedure prints GUSE-RX 23, so the status is set before the procedure runs. cite.py: OK §1985:VIII.1.3.5 GR1 the text is in GR1; OK §1985:VIII.1.3.4 GRL2.3 the text is in GRL2.3.
